demo.question: Is Orion a real bank?
demo.answer: No. Orion is a demo project: balances, transactions and rates are simulated, and no real money moves.

open.question: How do I open an account?
open.answer: Click “Open an account”, enter any valid email and a password of at least 8 characters — the demo signs you in instantly.

crypto.question: Which crypto assets are supported?
crypto.answer: The demo includes Bitcoin, Ethereum, Tether and Solana wallets alongside euro, dollar and pound accounts.

security.question: How is my account protected?
security.answer: Settings include two-factor authentication and active session management. In the demo these controls are placeholders.

fees.question: Are there any fees?
fees.answer: Every transfer shows its fee before you confirm. Fees are calculated by the demo for illustration only.

cta.title: Ready to try Orion?
cta.text: Open a demo account in under a minute — no documents needed.

footer.tagline: Next-generation banking demo: fiat and crypto in one account.
